method.fps: requestAnimationFrame intervals while the harness scrolls a fully local static page; this is desktop CPU-throttled evidence, not a physical-phone benchmark
method.contrast: All visible text is made transparent for a second render. Every second background pixel in each original text run rectangle is compared with its original computed foreground color; elementFromPoint excludes text pixels occluded by sticky or overlapping elements. This is a conservative rectangle test; photo backgrounds flagged by it require visual review.
